mapper.select: SELECT id FROM stock_daily_analysis WHERE watch_id = #{watchId} AND `date` = #{date}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stock_daily_analysis (id, watch_id, code, `date`, action_type, sentiment, target_buy_price, target_buy_price_high, target_sell_price, target_sell_price_high, stop_loss_price, stop_loss_price_high, buy_share_count, sell_share_count, loss_share_count, note, next_day_note, review_result, review_note, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{watchId}, #{code}, #{date}, #{actionType}, #{sentiment}, #{targetBuyPrice}, #{targetBuyPriceHigh}, #{targetSellPrice}, #{targetSellPriceHigh}, #{stopLossPrice}, #{stopLossPriceHigh}, #{buyShareCount}, #{sellShareCount}, #{lossShareCount}, #{note}, #{nextDayNote}, #{reviewResult}, #{reviewNote}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM stock_daily_analysis WHERE watch_id = #{watchId} AND `date` = #{date}
